title: Security/Deploy Gate Formalization
trigger_conditions: Project contains .env file with non-placeholder values
Project contains deploy scripts (SSH, scp, rsync, ansible, terraform)
Project contains server IPs or hostnames in config
Project contains API keys, tokens, or credentials in any file
Project README mentions deployment steps to real servers

gate_checks.check: Secret audit: no secret values printed in any output
Working-copy does not contain original production credentials in plaintext
User rotation checklist generated (items, not values)
Security hardening changes are config/docs only, not app logic

blocking_rule: If any BLOCKING check fails, phase CANNOT PASS. Non-blocking checks produce warnings.
integration_points: Build Lite: run after working-copy creation, before any modifications
Package QA Gate: run as part of final delivery check
Staging Pack: include Security/Deploy Gate result in staging bundle
user_rotation_boundary: Security/Deploy Gate MUST generate user rotation checklist but MUST NOT rotate secrets. See Section F.
realworld2_evidence: 10/10 security gates passed in P2; 9 files changed (config/docs), 0 app code
